name: Love & Hauntings
source:
As you arrive in New Zealand, your mind is overwhelmed with conflicting thoughts. You hear voices in your head – and outside your head, too. Which voice will you heed?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你來到紐西蘭時，紛亂矛盾的念頭一股腦兒湧上心頭。你聽見腦子裡有人說話——腦子外面也有。你會聽從哪個聲音？

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
